title: Everyday Phrases — Requesting Time Off
title_quote: Hi, do you handle vacation requests?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🌴 實用請假必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Requesting Time Off
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用請假情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從查年假、系統提單、跟主管溝通、交接同事，到臨時病假與補打卡，全程用最常用的 A2 英文短句完成。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多職場場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Requesting Time Off phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering annual leave requests, talking to your boss, handoff to coworkers, sick calls and timesheet fixes. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life workplace scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, do you handle vacation requests?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，請假申請是你處理的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I work in the HR team.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ wɜrk ɪn ði ˌeɪtʃˈɑr tim./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you check my leave balance first?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju tʃɛk maɪ liv ˈbæləns fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 能不能先幫我查一下假額？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, I can look it up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many vacation days do I have?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni vəˈkeɪʃən deɪz du aɪ hæv?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You have eight days left now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight days, that is nice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They reset every January first.
dialogue.zh: 每年一月一日會重新計算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I save days for next year?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ seɪv deɪz fər nɛkst jɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把假留到明年嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only three days can carry over.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens to the extra days?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They expire, so please use them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to book time off soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tu bʊk taɪm ɔf sun./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The online system is the fastest way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɑnˌlaɪn ˈsɪstəm ɪz ðə ˈfæstɪst weɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the request system easy?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very easy, it takes two minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I open the page?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Click the leave tab on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪk ðə liv tæb ɑn ðə lɛft./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I log in first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, use your normal account.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which leave type should I pick?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For a trip, choose annual leave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Annual leave means paid days, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, your pay stays the same.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I select my start date.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then choose the end date too.
dialogue.zh: 然後也把結束日期選好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should weekends count as leave?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the system skips weekends.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a public holiday count?
dialogue.zh: 國定假日會被算進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Holidays do not use your days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take just half a day?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ teɪk dʒʌst hæf ə deɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pick morning or afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half days are great for errands.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Many people use them that way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I plan four days next month.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four days from Wednesday to Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and it ends on Saturday.
dialogue.zh: 對，最後一天正好是週六。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart plan, everyone loves that.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，大家都愛這種排法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The form asks for a reason.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it short and simple.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I write a family trip?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is a perfect reason.
dialogue.zh: 那是再合適不過的理由。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to explain more?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, one line is enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I name my travel place?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can skip the location.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far ahead should I apply?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For vacation, two weeks minimum.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two weeks before my first day?
dialogue.zh: 請假第一天前的兩週嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, earlier is even better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my plans change fast?
dialogue.zh: 如果我的安排變得很快呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Edit the request in the system.
dialogue.zh: 在系統裡修改申請就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I cancel a request too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, before your boss approves it.
dialogue.zh: 可以，在主管核準前都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who approves my leave request?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your manager first, then HR records it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈmænɪdʒər fɜrst, ðɛn ˌeɪtʃˈɑr ˈrɛkərdz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 先由主管核準，人資再建檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does approval usually take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About one or two working days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I get a message online?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the system sends you email.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If I submit it now, can you see it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ səbˈmɪt ɪt naʊ, kæn ju si ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 如果現在送件，你那邊看得到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then it shows as pending.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pending means waiting for approval?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, just be patient a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I print the confirmation?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not needed, it saves automatically.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I see my leave history?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ si maɪ liv ˈhɪstəri?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the my leave section.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it show days used this year?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ɪt ʃoʊ deɪz juzd ðɪs jɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 會顯示今年用掉的假嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, every approved day is listed.
dialogue.zh: 會，每一天核准假都列得清清楚楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I took two days back in spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ tʊk tu deɪz bæk ɪn sprɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The record shows that clearly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The system is really convenient.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much better than paper forms.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any tips before I close the page?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni tɪps bɪˈfɔr aɪ kloʊz ðə peɪdʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 關頁面之前還有建議嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Double check your dates once more.
dialogue.zh: 再把日期從頭確認一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good call, typos happen easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrong dates delay the approval.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My trip is in early December.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is our busiest season.
dialogue.zh: 那可是我們最忙的季節。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Many coworkers want the holiday weeks.
dialogue.zh: 很多同事都想排假日那幾週。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So early requests get priority.
dialogue.zh: 所以早遞交的申請會優先。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, I will submit today.
dialogue.zh: 了解，我今天就把單送出。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, I will watch for it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does sick leave use the same page?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz sɪk liv juz ðə seɪm peɪdʒ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same page, but a different type.
dialogue.zh: 同一頁，但要選別的假別。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sick days do not touch annual leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪk deɪz du nɑt tʌtʃ ˈænjuəl liv./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Correct, they have their own balance.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，病假有獨立的額度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many sick days do people get?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni sɪk deɪz du ˈpipəl ɡɛt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five paid sick days per year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice, I hope I need none.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fingers crossed for both of us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last question about the form.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, I am happy to help.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd, aɪ æm ˈhæpi tu hɛlp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I attach any document?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not for normal vacation requests.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, everything makes sense now.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，現在全都清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enjoy planning your time off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for your patient help.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你這麼有耐心地幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, see you at the office.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ms. Lee, do you have a minute?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɪmɪs li, du ju hæv ə ˈmɪnɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, come in and sit down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today I would like to talk about leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ aɪ wʊd laɪk tu tɔk əˈbaʊt liv./
dialogue.zh: 今天想跟您討論請假的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, what are the dates?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: December ninth through twelfth, four days.
dialogue.zh: 十二月九日到十二日，四天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check my calendar first.
dialogue.zh: 我先看一下我的行事曆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, look whenever you can.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, that week looks pretty open.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那一週看起來還算空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All set, the request is filed online.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl sɛt, ðə rɪˈkwɛst ɪz faɪld ˈɑnˌlaɪn./
dialogue.zh: 單子我已經在線上提好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I will review it today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course we are busy right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs wi ɑr ˈbɪzi raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我當然知道最近公司很忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the launch is next month.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my project be a problem?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honestly, the timing is tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But I can finish my part early.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt aɪ kæn ˈfɪnɪʃ maɪ pɑrt ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: 不過我可以提前做完我的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How early could you finish it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By December third, if all goes well.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ dɪˈsɛmbər θɜrd, ɪf ɔl goʊz wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 如果一切順利，十二月三日前能完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That would make me feel better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if something still needs me?
dialogue.zh: 如果有事還是需要我怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can ask Tom for backup.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tom is great with that system.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, he knows the client side too.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, hi noʊz ðə ˈklaɪənt saɪd tu./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me prepare notes for Tom.
dialogue.zh: 我來幫湯姆準備交接筆記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The more detail, the better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing I should mention.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go on, what is it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam wants the same week off.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that could be tricky.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He applied before I did.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, his request came in first.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，他的單子是先進來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So he gets priority, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually the first request wins.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sounds fair to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Could you shift a few days?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For example, start on Sunday?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then Sunday through Wednesday off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That still gives me four days.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And Sam keeps his original plan.
dialogue.zh: 山姆也能照原來的規劃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Works for me, let us do that.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrks fər mi, lɛt ʌs du ðæt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for being so flexible.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I change the online request?
dialogue.zh: 那我要改線上的申請嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, cancel it and send a new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ˈkænsl ɪt ænd sɛnd ə nu wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 不用，取消重送一份新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will update it right after this.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ˈəpˌdeɪt ɪt raɪt ˈæftər ðɪs./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, I will approve the new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, aɪ wɪl əˈpruv ðə nu wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So we have a deal today?
dialogue.zh: 所以今天就這樣說定了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you are good to go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes me really happy.
dialogue.zh: 聽您這樣說我太開心了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone deserves a real break.
dialogue.zh: 每個人都該好好放個假。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Expect my email with the new dates.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈspɛkt maɪ ˈemɪl wɪð ðə nu deɪts./
dialogue.zh: 新日期我會發信件跟你確認。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, please confirm everything in writing.
dialogue.zh: 好，請白紙黑字留個紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Writing it down avoids confusion.
dialogue.zh: 寫下來比較不會有誤會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: HR needs the paper trail too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I copy the team on it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ˈkɑpi ðə tim ɑn ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 這封信要副本給團隊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, keep everyone in the loop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What subject line works best?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just write leave request dates.
dialogue.zh: 寫上請假申請日期即可。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Simple and clear, got it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: List the dates in the first line.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪst ðə deɪts ɪn ðə fɜrst laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 第一行先把日期列出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then my backup coverage plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tom should be mentioned there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right now, my report comes first.
dialogue.zh: 我手邊的報告要優先處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which report needs it most?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The budget file for finance.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is due December fifth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It will be done by Friday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday is December fourth, right?
dialogue.zh: 週五是十二月四日，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, so it is done before I leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, soʊ ɪt ɪz dʌn bɪˈfɔr aɪ liv./
dialogue.zh: 對，所以在我休假前就會完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I have no worries.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything else you need from me?
dialogue.zh: 還有什麼需要我做的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Update the shared task board.
dialogue.zh: 把共用任務板更新一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will mark my status today.
dialogue.zh: 我今天會標註我的進度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, that keeps things visible.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more question for you.
dialogue.zh: 還有一個小問題想請教。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What do you need?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I leave early next Friday?
dialogue.zh: 下週五我可以早點走嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For what reason, if I may ask?
dialogue.phonetic: /fər wʌt ˈrizən, ɪf aɪ meɪ æsk?/
dialogue.zh: 如果方便說，是什麼原因？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just a dentist appointment that day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, just send a note.
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，傳個訊息說一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are very kind, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We all have lives outside work.
dialogue.zh: 工作之外大家也有生活。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the leave plan is final now?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə liv plæn ɪz ˈfaɪnəl naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 所以請假的安排定案了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I approve it verbally here.
dialogue.zh: 對，我在這裡先口頭核準。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The system approval will still come?
dialogue.zh: 系統那邊的核準還會下來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, watch for it by tomorrow.
dialogue.zh: 會，明天之前你就會看到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If not, I will knock on your door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf nɑt, aɪ wɪl nɑk ɑn jʊr dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 如果沒收到，我會去敲您的門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, my days get crazy.
dialogue.zh: 務必提醒我，我忙起來會忘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel much better about this.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Talking first always helps.
dialogue.zh: 事先當面溝通總是有用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I will ask sooner.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Early notice makes my job easier.
dialogue.zh: 提前告知讓我好安排多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted, I will plan ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And send that email today.
dialogue.zh: 今天把那封郵件發出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It will be written tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep me on the to line.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Copy Tom and the team too?
dialogue.zh: 也副本給湯姆和團隊嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, short and friendly, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This went better than I feared.
dialogue.zh: 這比我想像中順利多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Asking face to face matters.
dialogue.zh: 面對面開口說總是不一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for your time, Ms. Lee.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, have a wonderful trip.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tom, can I borrow you a moment?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑm, kæn aɪ ˈbɑˌroʊ ju ə ˈmoʊmənt?/
dialogue.zh: 湯姆，借用你一點時間好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, what do you need?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tom, I need help while I am away.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑm, aɪ nid hɛlp waɪl aɪ æm əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 湯姆，我不在的時候要請你幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You are on vacation that week?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, Sunday through Wednesday off.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, I will cover for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm, aɪ wɪl ˈkʌvər fər ju./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me walk you through my tasks.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi wɔk ju θru maɪ tæsks./
dialogue.zh: 我帶你過一遍我的手邊事項。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I brought my notebook.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, the client list is here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Are any clients active right now?
dialogue.zh: 現在有哪幾個客戶比較活躍嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mrs. Chen emails almost daily.
dialogue.zh: 陳太太幾乎每天都發信。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What should I do about her emails?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ʃʊd aɪ du əˈbaʊt hɜr ˈemɪlz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reply politely and copy me.
dialogue.zh: 有禮地回覆，並副本給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will answer within one day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Second, my files are in the shared folder.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd, maɪ faɪlz ɑr ɪn ðə ʃɛrd ˈfoʊldər./
dialogue.zh: 再來，我的檔案在共用資料夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I need a special password?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, your login already works.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, access is never an issue then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, ˈækˌsɛs ɪz ˈnɛvər ən ˈɪʃu ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那存取完全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The dashboard link is in my notes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdæʃˌbɔrd lɪŋk ɪz ɪn maɪ noʊts./
dialogue.zh: 儀表板連結寫在我的筆記裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which notes file did you use?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today I made a handoff document.
dialogue.zh: 我今天整理了一份交接文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is so thoughtful of you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It lists progress, contacts and deadlines.
dialogue.zh: 裡面有進度、聯絡人和期限。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you include the meeting times?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, every standing meeting is noted.
dialogue.zh: 有，每個例行會議都記了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I join them for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only the Tuesday project check-in.
dialogue.zh: 只有週二的專案進度會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will take notes there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please send me nothing urgent.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But what if the server breaks?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only real emergencies, like that.
dialogue.zh: 只有像那樣的大緊急狀況。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So I may call your phone?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I will leave my number.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will text first, then call.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a polite plan.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope your trip stays peaceful.
dialogue.zh: 希望你的假期平靜無風波。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now for the contact sheet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Who handles billing questions fast?
dialogue.zh: 帳單問題找誰處理最快？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask Linda in the finance team.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does she know I am covering?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She knows, I told her just now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi noʊz, aɪ toʊld hɜr dʒʌst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 她知道，我剛剛就跟她說了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, no blockers for me then.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那我就沒阻礙了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want a quick demo?
dialogue.zh: 你想先看個快速示範嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, show me the order process.
dialogue.zh: 好，示範一下下訂單流程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch this, it takes three steps.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, open, confirm, then save.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that is exactly right.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will run it once myself.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea, before Friday ideally.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，最好能在週五前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will test it tomorrow morning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About my email signature now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I change anything there?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will set an out of office reply.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl sɛt ən aʊt ʌv ˈɔfəs rɪˈplaɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it short and clear.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You will be listed as the contact.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju wɪl bi ˈlɪstɪd æz ðə ˈkɑnˌtækt./
dialogue.zh: 回覆裡會把你列成聯絡窗口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, people can reach me easily.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The auto reply says I return Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɔtoʊ rɪˈplaɪ sɛz aɪ rɪˈtɜrn ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ./
dialogue.zh: 自動回覆會寫我週四回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That stops people from waiting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight, I will turn it on.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Test it with your own address.
dialogue.zh: 用你自己的信箱測試一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good tip, I almost forgot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Test it twice, trust me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My tasks are almost all done.
dialogue.zh: 我的事情差不多都清完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What still needs finishing?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just one invoice to send out.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can send it for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? That helps a lot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friends cover each other.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you check my checklist file?
dialogue.zh: 你有看到我的清單檔案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, item by item is clear.
dialogue.zh: 有，每一項都寫得很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything is numbered, step by step.
dialogue.zh: 我每步驟都照順序編了號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That makes my job so easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything confusing in the document?
dialogue.zh: 文件裡有什麼讓人困惑的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing so far, it reads well.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will add the meeting room codes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl æd ðə ˈmitɪŋ rum koʊdz./
dialogue.zh: 我會補上會議室的密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call, those change often.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the monthly survey?
dialogue.zh: 那個月度調查怎麼處理？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that due next Monday?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I will send it before I leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ wɪl sɛnd ɪt bɪˈfɔr aɪ liv./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, then nothing waits for you.
dialogue.zh: 好，那樣就沒有事情等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before I go, one last thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plants need watering, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, mine and the corner one.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，我的那盆和角落那盆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I water them every three days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You thought of everything, Tom.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your notes made it easy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How will you greet my clients?
dialogue.zh: 你要怎麼跟我的客戶打招呼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same email style, just different sender.
dialogue.zh: 用同樣的寫法，只是換發件人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They will love how prepared you are.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɪl lʌv haʊ prɪˈpɛrd ju ɑr./
dialogue.zh: 他們會驚嘆你準備得這麼齊全。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your document did all the work.
dialogue.zh: 功勞都在你那份交接文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The printer jams sometimes, sorry.
dialogue.zh: 印表機偶爾會卡紙，先說聲抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where is the spare paper box?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under my desk, next to the bin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər maɪ dɛsk, nɛkst tu ðə bɪn./
dialogue.zh: 在我桌子下，垃圾桶旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, I can handle the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt, aɪ kæn ˈhændl ðə rɛst./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I am feeling quite relaxed.
dialogue.zh: 我現在已經覺得很放鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the point of a vacation.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə pɔɪnt ʌv ə vəˈkeɪʃən./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Beach photos will come your way.
dialogue.zh: 海邊照片我會記得傳給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if the wifi allows it.
dialogue.zh: 前提是你那邊收得到訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, deal, see you Thursday then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have fun, you really earned it.
dialogue.zh: 盡情玩吧，這假期是你掙來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This morning I woke up feeling terrible.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ aɪ woʊk ʌp ˈfilɪŋ ˈtɛrəbəl./
dialogue.zh: 今早醒來我整個人超不舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, are you running a fever?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ, ɑr ju ˈrʌnɪŋ ə ˈfivər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, a sore throat too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then please stay home today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So I need to call in sick early.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ aɪ nid tu kɔl ɪn sɪk ˈɜrli./
dialogue.zh: 所以我得早點打病假通報。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A morning call is the rule here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈmɔrnɪŋ kɔl ɪz ðə rul hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 這裡的規矩是早上通報。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I message the team group?
dialogue.zh: 我可以在團隊群組發消息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call first, then message everyone.
dialogue.zh: 先打電話，再發訊息通知大家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who do I notify, you or HR?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu du aɪ ˈnoʊtəˌfaɪ, ju ɔr ˌeɪtʃˈɑr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me first, I will tell HR.
dialogue.zh: 先跟我說，人資由我來轉達。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I file it in the system too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ faɪl ɪt ɪn ðə ˈsɪstəm tu?/
dialogue.zh: 系統裡也要補一個單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, submit a sick leave request.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At first it felt not so bad.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt fɜrst ɪt fɛlt nɑt soʊ bæd./
dialogue.zh: 剛開始時其實還不算太糟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sickness often strikes by noon.
dialogue.zh: 病痛常常到了中午才發作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I tried to work through it.
dialogue.zh: 我試著撐著把工作做完。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But you pushed too hard again.
dialogue.zh: 但你又把自己逼太緊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe a half day is enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest now, decide by noon.
dialogue.zh: 先休息，到中午再做決定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By noon I felt much worse.
dialogue.zh: 到了中午我感覺更糟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take the whole day off.
dialogue.zh: 那就把一整天假都休了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I use personal leave instead?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if your sick days are gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf jʊr sɪk deɪz ɑr ɡɔn./
dialogue.zh: 只有病假用完了，才改用事假。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My paid sick days are not used yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ peɪd sɪk deɪz ɑr nɑt juzd jɛt./
dialogue.zh: 我的有薪病假一天都還沒用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then sick leave is your best pick.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn sɪk liv ɪz jʊr bɛst pɪk./
dialogue.zh: 那病假就是你最好的選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to visit a doctor?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ hæv tu ˈvɪzɪt ə ˈdɑktər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if it lasts over two days.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ɪt læsts ˈoʊvər tu deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 如果超過兩天才要去看診。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It has been three days already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then yes, book a clinic visit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wait there is so long.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go right when they open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea, I will go at eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə, aɪ wɪl ɡoʊ æt eɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask for a note while you are there.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk fər ə noʊt waɪl ju ɑr ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 順便在診所開一張證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You mean a doctor's note?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, HR needs it for three days.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˌeɪtʃˈɑr nidz ɪt fər θri deɪz./
dialogue.zh: 對，請三天以上人資要附證明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which clinic is closest to home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one on Maple Street.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I make an appointment online?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call them, walk ins are fine too.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ðɛm, wɔk ɪnz ɑr faɪn tu./
dialogue.zh: 打給他們，直接去也可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The doctor was quick and kind.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did she write your note?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, here it is, signed and stamped.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hɪr ɪt ɪz, saɪnd ænd stæmpt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, scan it and email it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I also keep the paper?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bring it when you return.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I emailed it to HR just now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈemɪld ɪt tu ˌeɪtʃˈɑr dʒʌst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我剛剛已經把掃描檔寄給人資。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will mark your leave as excused.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl mɑrk jʊr liv æz ɪkˈskjuzd./
dialogue.zh: 人資會把你的假標為准假。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excused means it is official?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, no pay will be touched.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back at work again today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome back, how do you feel?
dialogue.zh: 歡迎回來，你感覺怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Much better, just a light cough.
dialogue.zh: 好多了，只剩輕輕的咳嗽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it slow for a few days.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt sloʊ fər ə fju deɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for covering my work.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is what teammates are for.
dialogue.zh: 隊友就是為這個存在的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Word is you handled everything well.
dialogue.zh: 大家都說你把事情處理得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your handoff notes saved me.
dialogue.zh: 你的交接筆記幫了我大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me buy you a coffee.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you rest up first.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但你得先養好身體。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, this thank you is serious.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will gladly accept.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did anyone ask about my report?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just two small follow up emails.
dialogue.zh: 只有兩封簡單的跟進信。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Later today I will answer them.
dialogue.zh: 今天晚些時候我會回覆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing caught fire, do not worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My timesheet looks wrong somehow.
dialogue.zh: 我的工時表看起來怪不對勁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You missed your clock in, right?
dialogue.zh: 你有幾天漏打卡了，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I forgot while I was sick.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ fərˈɡɑt waɪl aɪ wʌz sɪk./
dialogue.zh: 對，生病那幾天我根本忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That created a missing record.
dialogue.zh: 所以系統才會缺了紀錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I fix a bad timesheet?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ fɪks ə bæd ˈtaɪmˌʃit?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fill a correction form online.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who signs off on it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your manager, then payroll checks it.
dialogue.zh: 你的主管，然後薪資組會複核。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I edit old days too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only within the current pay period.
dialogue.zh: 只能在當期計薪週期內改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does this period close?
dialogue.zh: 這個計薪週期何時結算？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Friday at five sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will fix it right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl fɪks ɪt raɪt naʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, late forms get rejected.
dialogue.zh: 聰明，逾期補單會被退件。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which days should I mark as absent?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ deɪz ʃʊd aɪ mɑrk æz ˈæbsənt?/
dialogue.zh: 我該把哪幾天標記為缺席？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the three sick days.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I note the doctor visit too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ noʊt ðə ˈdɑktər ˈvɪzɪt tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add the note number as proof.
dialogue.zh: 把證明的編號填進去當佐證。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, can you take a look?
dialogue.zh: 填好了，你能幫我看一眼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Looks clean, I will approve it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are a real lifesaver.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank me later, get some rest.
dialogue.zh: 客氣話之後再說，先好好休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, how do comp days work?
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə weɪ, haʊ du kɑm deɪz wɜrk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Extra hours become time off later.
dialogue.zh: 加班時數之後可換成放假。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last week I worked really late.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Log the hours before Friday comes.
dialogue.zh: 週五前要把工時登錄好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do comp days expire at year end?
dialogue.phonetic: /du kɑm deɪz ɪkˈspaɪr æt jɪr ɛnd?/
dialogue.zh: 補休假會在年底過期嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, use them by December thirty.
dialogue.zh: 會，十二月三十日前要用完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I stack two comp days?
dialogue.zh: 我可以把兩天補休連著用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, request them like normal leave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a limit per month?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three days maximum, no more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good to know, I will plan smart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tu noʊ, aɪ wɪl plæn smɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 知道了，我會聰明地安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Healthy body, healthy work.
dialogue.zh: 身體健康，工作才走得長遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You really helped me today.
dialogue.zh: 你今天真的幫了我很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest well today, you deserve it.
dialogue.zh: 今天好好休息，你應得的。
